description: An expander for Alchemist, going immediately to its left, that adds mute-all and solo-all buttons, an exclusive mode for each, and polyphonic CV over every channel's mute and solo

params.text: Mutes and unmutes all sixteen Alchemist channels at once; it is switched off again by a solo-all, or by unmuting or soloing any single channel on the Alchemist
Makes muting one channel on the Alchemist unmute all the others; the panel prints EX., and turning it on takes the mute-all button out of use
Solos and unsolos all sixteen Alchemist channels at once; it is switched off again by a mute-all, or by unsoloing or muting any single channel on the Alchemist
Makes soloing one channel on the Alchemist unsolo all the others; the panel prints EX., and turning it on takes the solo-all button out of use

inputs.text: Engages mute-all while the voltage stands at 1V or more
Mutes each Alchemist channel whose voltage on this polyphonic cable stands at 1V or more, one channel of cable per mixer channel
Engages solo-all while the voltage stands at 1V or more
Solos each Alchemist channel whose voltage on this polyphonic cable stands at 1V or more, one channel of cable per mixer channel

notes: The expander does nothing on its own: it has to be immediately to the left of an Alchemist, and the light at its top right comes on when the two are talking.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
